kit_row.help:
Persistent type for new clones.
Overlay clone: A light copy that re-draws the source avatar's own mesh at another spot. It mirrors what the source is doing, or holds a pose you freeze. Cheapest; best for crowds and echoes. Drawn after fog and haze, so atmosphere doesn't touch it.
Entity clone: A real avatar that exists only in your viewer, with its own skeleton. It can play its own animations (copy the source, a chosen animation, true mirror, or auto-animate), and has its own scale, physics, eye motion, speed and stepping. Lit, fogged and hazed like a real avatar. Heavier per copy.
kit_row.keywords: type overlay ghost entity clone persistent new ghosts clones
kit_row.label: Type

combo_box.name: clone_type_combo
combo_box.tool_tip:

It can play its own animations (copy the source, a chosen animation, true mirror, or auto-animate), and has its own scale, physics, eye motion, speed and stepping. kit_row.help: While held, replay each finished one-shot animation so a retriggered tail keeps cycling. Adds a small seam per cycle.
kit_row.keywords: repeat held replay one-shot animesh while finished animation
kit_row.label: Repeat held

kit_switch.name: mirror_repeat_held_check
kit_switch.tool_tip: Needs Hold on src change. While a clone's animesh is HELD (source detached/gone), replay each finished one-shot animesh animation so a script-retriggered tail or idle keeps cycling instead of freezing. Looping animations are untouched. Functional repetition, not seamless: a small seam per cycle, and a deliberate one-shot action will repeat too (hence off by default).
